Welcome to OrientEck!

Our restaurant is set in an attractive location, just a stone's throw from the beautiful green spaces and the popular recreation area around the Stuttgart TV Tower. Whether after a relaxing walk or some sporting activity, a break with us is always a good choice. Let our specialties spoil you in a pleasant atmosphere.

We look forward to your visit!
